expectations.text: States that API clients / API tokens issued by VCF SSO are a 9.1 feature and are NOT available in 9.0
expectations.evidence: "SSO-issued, role-scoped API tokens — the *Fleet Management → Identity & Access → API Clients / API Tokens* flow you have probably read about — are a **9.1** capability. On 9.0 there is no VCF SSO API client, no SSO-issued API token, no OAuth-app management and no emergency access client."

expectations.text: Does NOT walk the user through the 9.1 Fleet Management > Identity & Access > API Clients flow as if it existed in 9.0
expectations.evidence: "There is no `.../iam/ssorealms/{ssoRealmId}/api-tokens`, `.../api-clients`, `.../oauth-apps`, `.../emergency-clients` or `.../iam/settings` route to call on a 9.0 appliance." The API-client flow appears only under the clearly separated section "If you can move to 9.1, this gets much easier".

expectations.text: Gives the actual 9.0 route: per-product credentials (SDDC Manager /v1/tokens, VCF Operations token/acquire, NSX session, vCenter session)
